scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compute next-token log probabilities and per-sequence cumulative log probability.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Selected logit - rowmax - log(sum(exp(logit-rowmax))+1e-9), then sum31 positions per sequence.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 64 sequences of32 positions,256 vocabulary entries per position; full lengths only.
invariants: Finite normalized log probabilities are nonpositive in the fixture.
Each cumulative value equals the corresponding sequence-position sum within roundoff.
accuracy_requirements: All1984 positional plus64 cumulative Float32 outputs, absolute1e-3 against CPU and both references.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Max/sum reduction order, exp/log lowering and cumulative summation;1e-9 stabilizer retained.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Token/sequence likelihood operator; source alone does not identify a language model or domain dataset.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Only full-length sequences; no claim about masked/uninitialized slots or all vocabulary padding regimes.
